name: Hirukawa Hikaru
source: A girl who is the current No. 1 School Idol. At first she was just recruited to become an idol, but fastly rose up in the rankings. A girl who is always smiling and has exquisite communication skills. She rarely puts effort in anything except her idol activites, and it's also unknown just how Hikaru was able to get into the "wife candidate" class.
